text:
Jamie: Heads-up — working on a new Grafana panel that overlays 99p request latency with GPU core temperature and recent power-cap events. Want a compact per-rack sparkline + anomaly flags so SREs can see thermal-triggered latency spikes.
Carlos: Nice. Is this for model-serving only or all inference traffic?
Jamie: Start with model-serving routes (route=serve.*) — those have the tail we care about. Later can expand to training infra if this works.
Nina: Curious about cardinality. 99p by route x host could explode. Plan to roll up by rack and route prefix? :thinking_face:
Jamie: Exactly — roll up to rack_id and route_prefix (first two path segments). Also add a selectable breakdown dropdown for specific hosts when you click a rack.
Tyler: What PromQL are you thinking? I can sanity-check for cardinality and performance.
Jamie: Draft PromQL for panel series:

```
# 99th percentile request duration by rack
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="redwood-inference", route=~"serve/.*"}[5m])) by (le, rack_id))
```

And GPU temp series:

```
avg_over_time(gpu_core_temp_celsius{job="gpu_exporter"}[5m]) by (rack_id)
```

For power-cap events (we emit a gauge that flips to 1 for 60s when the scheduler applies a cap):

```
max_over_time(power_cap_event{job="scheduler"}[5m]) by (rack_id)
```

Jamie: We'll use transforms in Grafana to join by rack_id and then a single y-axis with 99p on left and temp/power as secondary, with event annotations.
Carlos: Looks reasonable. Two concerns: histogram_quantile on very high-cardinality labels can be slow; add `cluster="prod"` and limit route regex tighter. Also consider pre-aggregating via recording rules so dashboards query fast.
Jamie: Agreed — I'll ask infra-ml to add a recording rule: `record: infra:http_request_duration_seconds:99p_rate` with the sum(rate(...)) grouped by le and rack_id.
Nina: Alerting? If 99p > X ms and avg temp > Y C for N minutes, fire an incident. Want to propose thresholds.
Tyler: Proposal: 99p > 1200ms AND avg temp > 78C sustained 3m -> Sev2. If power_cap_event==1 at same time, route to infra-ops with `annotation=powercap`.
Sophie: Can we surface per-tenant cost impact too? e.g., correlate with token/sec so SREs can say this is load-driven.
Jamie: Good call — add a small bar under the sparkline: tokens_per_sec by rack. PromQL:

```
sum(rate(tokens_generated_total{job="redwood-api", route=~"serve/.*"}[1m])) by (rack_id)
```

Tyler: Also add an example panel JSON snippet for the team to reuse. Keep it lightweight.
Jamie: I'll push a patch to grafana-dashboards repo after we finalize queries and recording rules. Planning to land as a draft panel in staging dashboard first.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist reminder: create recording rule, update grafana provisioning JSON in staging, run `make validate-dashboards`, and ping #eng-sre for load-test.
Carlos: lgtm. Can you add a short note in the repo about expected query cardinality and recommended panel variable defaults (e.g., rack limit 50)?
Jamie: Will do. I'll post the PR link once ready. Thanks for the quick feedback :thumbsup:
